name: exp_Amstell-SL
summary: Amstell-SL is a trend-following Expert Advisor that uses moving average-based signals to enter trades in the direction of the prevailing trend, with built-in stop-loss management. The EA systematically identifies trend direction and enters positions when price action confirms the trend, applying protective stop-losses to limit downside risk. It is designed for medium-to-long term trading on higher timeframes.
summary_zh: Amstell-SL是一个趋势跟踪型智能交易系统，基于移动平均线信号沿 prevailing 趋势方向入场交易，并内置止损管理功能。该EA系统性地识别趋势方向，在价格行为确认趋势时建仓，并设置保护性止损以限制下行风险。它适用于较高时间框架的中长期交易。
strategy_analysis: 该EA采用趋势跟踪策略，核心概念是利用移动平均线判断市场趋势方向，并在趋势确认后顺势入场。入场条件通常基于价格与移动平均线的关系或均线交叉信号，当短期均线上穿长期均线时做多，反之做空。出场条件包括预设的止损和止盈水平，止损位的设置旨在将亏损控制在可接受范围内。仓位管理方面，EA可能采用固定手数或基于账户资金的动态仓位计算方法。资金管理通过止损水平与仓位大小的配合来控制单笔交易的风险敞口，确保不会因单次交易造成过大损失。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs a trend-following strategy with the core concept of using moving averages to determine market trend direction and entering trades in alignment with confirmed trends. Entry conditions are typically based on price-moving average relationships or moving average crossover signals, going long when the short-term MA crosses above the long-term MA and shorting on the reverse. Exit conditions include preset stop-loss and take-profit levels, where the stop-loss is designed to limit losses to an acceptable range. Position sizing may use fixed lot sizes or dynamic calculation based on account equity. Money management controls single-trade risk exposure through the coordination of stop-loss levels and position sizes, ensuring no single trade causes disproportionate damage to the account.

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术编号，用于识别本EA的订单
parameters.description_en: EA magic number for identifying this EA's orders

pros: 趋势跟踪策略逻辑清晰，易于理解和验证
内置止损管理，有效控制单笔交易风险
基于均线的趋势判断在趋势市场中表现稳定可靠
参数化设计允许用户根据不同市场环境灵活调整
系统化交易消除情绪干扰，执行纪律性强
pros_en: Clear trend-following logic that is easy to understand and verify
Built-in stop-loss management effectively controls per-trade risk
MA-based trend identification performs reliably in trending markets
Parameterized design allows flexible adjustment for different market conditions
Systematic trading eliminates emotional interference with strong execution discipline
cons: 趋势跟踪在震荡行情中容易产生频繁的虚假信号和亏损
缺乏市场状态过滤器，无法区分趋势市和震荡市
固定止损可能不适应不同波动率环境，低波动时止损过远高波动时过近
未包含加仓或移动止损等进阶仓位管理功能
单一指标依赖导致策略维度不足，信号确认不够充分
cons_en: Trend-following generates frequent false signals and losses in ranging/choppy markets
Lacks market regime filter to distinguish trending from ranging conditions
Fixed stop-loss may not adapt to varying volatility environments — too wide in low volatility, too tight in high volatility
No advanced position management features such as pyramiding or trailing stop
Single-indicator dependency results in insufficient strategy dimensions and inadequate signal confirmation
improvements: 增加震荡/趋势市场状态过滤器（如ADX或ATR），在震荡市中减少交易或暂停开仓
引入ATR动态止损替代固定点数止损，使止损适应当前市场波动率
添加移动止损功能，在趋势延续时锁定浮盈
improvements_en: Add a market regime filter (e.g., ADX or ATR) to reduce or pause trading in ranging markets
Replace fixed-pip stop-loss with ATR-based dynamic stop-loss that adapts to current market volatility
Implement trailing stop functionality to lock in floating profits as trends continue

risk_points: 固定止损在极端波动行情下可能被跳空滑点穿透
缺乏市场状态过滤导致震荡期连续亏损风险
单一均线指标在趋势转折点存在明显滞后
risk_points_en: Fixed stop-loss may be gapped through during extreme volatility with slippage
No market regime filter creates risk of consecutive losses during ranging periods
Single MA indicator has significant lag at trend reversal points

It is designed for medium-to-long term trading on higher timeframes.
